content.title: The Elmet Group | Securing Critical U.S. Components Supply Chain
content.text: Markets Key industry applications support critical national initiatives, including domestic manufacturing for Department of War and Department of Energy efforts. Energy Critical energy systems demand supply chain certainty and precision-engineered components to keep core infrastructure online. Key products for energy applications include nuclear fuel boats, transmission devices for fusion research, and microwave delivery systems for hydrogen, carbon capture, and fossil fuels processing. Learn More Medical When device failure is not an option, our components deliver the utmost reliability and ultra-precision that critical medical applications require. Our products support medical detection and treatment, imaging and oncology, isotope production, shielding, medical foam and polymer production, and x-ray filtering. Learn More Industrial Critical infrastructure depends on secure supply chains to ensure continuous uptime and maximum process efficiency. Our industrial materials, components, and systems support applications in chemical processing, glass manufacturing, food production, material transformation, vacuum furnaces, and more. Learn More Semiconductor & Electronics Supporting advanced semiconductor manufacturing with high-performance materials and components for extreme ultraviolet lithography, metal-organic chemical vapor deposition grids, ion implantation devices, heat sinks and studs, high-reliability diodes, high-density plasma generation components, and more. Learn More Aerospace, Defense & Government Our components and systems support high profile segments in missile systems, rocket launch vehicles, commercial and military aircraft, munitions, ordnance systems, satellite platforms, nuclear submarines, propulsion technology, radar tracking communications, directed energy systems, and beyond.
